meta.name: architecture-patterns
meta.description: Implement proven backend architecture patterns including Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design. Use this skill when designing clean architecture for a new microservice, when refactoring a monolith to use bounded contexts, when implementing hexagonal or onion architecture patterns, or when debugging dependency cycles between application layers.

copy.tagline_en: Design clean backend architecture and eliminate tangled dependencies.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Clean Architecture、六边形架构和 DDD 帮你划分分层结构、定义接口与测试边界,依赖只向内,并给出无需数据库的单元测试写法。
howto.when: 当你设计新微服务的架构、把单体按限界上下文重构,或排查层间依赖循环时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我为一个新微服务设计分层结构
我的业务逻辑和 ORM 模型缠在一起,怎么拆?
say.note: 按限界上下文给出拆分方向

say.text: use_cases 和 adapters 循环导入怎么修?

howto.what_en: Claude applies Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture and DDD to lay out layers, define interfaces and test boundaries, keeping dependencies pointing inward, with unit tests that need no real database.
howto.when_en: Use it when designing a new microservice's architecture, refactoring a monolith by bounded contexts, or debugging dependency cycles between layers.
